verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs show real API versioning in practice (payment/v1/rules, payment/v2/payins, and a Transfers v3 API that formally replaces the legacy Quote API with a migration guide), evidencing that versioning and deprecation happen. However, there is no explicit documented deprecation policy (e.g., sunset timelines, notice periods, version support windows) for AI-native users to rely on. Missing for 10: a formal deprecation/versioning policy document, sunset dates or support windows, and any independent confirmation that deprecated versions remain stable during transition.
